claim: A fenced or commented pseudo `## Performance Targets` heading is ignored by target parsing but still treated as a declaration during policy validation, causing a false `performance policy mismatch` when performance policy is disabled.
preconditions: Include ordinary prose without the heading and a real target section as negative and positive declaration controls.
expected_behavior: Assert each input produces a performance policy mismatch while ParsePerformanceTargets returns no targets or findings.

predicted_failure.assertion: Assert each input produces a performance policy mismatch while ParsePerformanceTargets returns no targets or findings.
